Regiment was formed in 1821 Dodbridge Era during the Flokan Rebellion. 2nd Fleet is based in Kemabing. 

Regiment composition in 1826 DE:
— fleet: 2.

notes.name: Mount Widetownby
notes.legend: Dormant volcano. Height: 5929m.

notes.name: Brorough Hot Springs
notes.legend: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 20°C.

notes.name: Cambridford Healing Spring
notes.legend: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

notes.name: Calton — salt mining town
notes.legend: Calton is a mining town of 665 people just nearby the salt mine.

notes.name: Cambrid — silver mining town
notes.legend: Cambrid is a mining town of 509 people just nearby the silver mine.

notes.name: Tiverton — gold mining town
notes.legend: Tiverton is a mining town of 493 people just nearby the gold mine.

notes.name: Picker — salt mining town
notes.legend: Picker is a mining town of 4439 people just nearby the salt mine.

notes.name: Warporwick — silver mining town
notes.legend: Warporwick is a mining town of 1186 people just nearby the silver mine.

notes.name: Rothbury Bridge
notes.legend: A lengthy bridge spans over the Bruton River near Rothbury.

notes.name: The Favorable Elk
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious pickled elk with misty sap is served here.

notes.name: The Brown Goose
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside tavern. Delicious spit-roasted chickpea with bitter water is served here.

notes.name: The Prime Inn

notes.name: The Sunny Tavern

notes.name: The Orange Eagle

notes.name: The Amber Sheep
notes.legend: A big and famous roadside inn. Delicious grilled hart with cold liquor is served here.

notes.name: Kerewesham Monster
notes.legend: Elders say a relic monster of 7 m long inhabits Kerewesham Lake. Truth or lie, folks are afraid to fish in the lake.

notes.name: Prestone Monster
notes.legend: Old sailors tell stories of a gigantic sea monster inhabiting these dangerous waters. Rumors say it can be 52 m long.

notes.name: Bethamney Ogre
notes.legend: Journeying folk speak of a golden Ogre who inhabits Bethamney hills and eats kids whole.

notes.name: Pentondore Forest
notes.legend: A forest sacred to local Pantheon of the Light Centaur.

notes.legend: A palm grove sacred to local Seare Spirits.

notes.name: Stapleton Statue
notes.legend:
An ancient statue. It has an inscription, but no one can translate it:
ለፐፈለዘገአፈዐበሰተዘዘረአአ ጸቀጸ በ ኀአየጸሠገደመቀከሀደ ለቀፈየ አሰቀተፈየወጰቀ

notes.legend:

༸༴༛༗༡༣༆༆༯༐༰༊༱༑༺༘༕༣༚༇༺༗༓༚༄༨༪༚༹༘༩༼༢༜༐༌༶༸༢༳༚༮༹༘༊༷༨༜༸༦༑༫༂༺༷༅༻༿༑༖༾༉༂༩༛༮༣༳༺༄༽༹༼༑༹༡༲༠༵༤༜

notes.legend: Ruins of an ancient fortification. Untold riches may lie within.

notes.legend: Ruins of an ancient sacred site. Untold riches may lie within.

notes.name: Ruined City
notes.legend: Ruins of an ancient city. Untold riches may lie within.

notes.name: Amersmouth Collection
notes.legend: A vast collection of knowledge, including many rare and ancient tomes.

notes.name: Travelling Fantastical Circus
notes.legend: Roll up, roll up, this fantastical circus is here for a limited time only.

notes.name: Travelling Wondrous Circus
notes.legend: Roll up, roll up, this wondrous circus is here for a limited time only.

notes.name: Penden Melee
notes.legend: Warriors from around the land gather for a melee of the greats in Penden, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

notes.name: Lympscom Fair
notes.legend: A fair is being held in Lympscom, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

notes.name: Oxen migration
notes.legend: A huge group of oxen are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

notes.name: Distant mirage
notes.legend: This distant mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

notes.name: Diaphanous mirage
notes.legend: This diaphanous mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

notes.name: Castford Cave
notes.legend: The Castford Cave. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

notes.name: Dodbrid Necropolis
notes.legend: A labyrinthine necropolis where each step echoes with haunting murmurs. The walls are adorned with ancient runes, and restless spirits guide or hinder those who dare to delve into its depths.
